posts.name: Finyuus
posts.tagline: A code-first language for durable, governed AI workflows

Unlike visual builders, workflows are stored as text for Git-based review and diffs. Unlike prompt chains, every run is durable, versioned, observable via Langfuse, and governable through guards and human approvals.

posts.name: Yokoso

posts.name: whack.sh
posts.tagline: Whack the moles your current scanner can't see.

Then diffs the captures to expose cloaking, TDS, phishing sites and malware a datacenter-only IP scanner misses. Datacenter egress is free (first 5MB/scan); our curl API drives every tier, free or paid.

posts.name: NovumOS
posts.tagline: Assign kanban cards to AI agents. An agent seat is $1
posts.description: NovumOS is a kanban board where you assign cards to AI agents the same way you assign them to people. Connect Claude Code in one command. Agents pull work from a queue, do it, and log every step on the card, so you always know what they did. Set a spending cap per agent, and pause it with one click if it goes off the rails. Agents run on your own API keys. No credit meters or token markups. $1 per agent seat. Free for 5 people and 1 agent.

posts.name: Retune - Guitar Tuner
posts.tagline: iOS guitar tuner without any ads, accounts, or data tracking
posts.description: Most free guitar tuners bombard you with ads or upsells to a monthly plan. Retune loads the tuning first, so it knows the string you played and holds steady while you turn the peg, and includes tunings for free, with bass and ukulele included. Pro adds a custom tuning feature, metronome, and iCloud sync for a one-time $4.99 purchase.

posts.name: Visibility100x
posts.tagline: Free Technical SEO & AI visibility audit of your whole site.
posts.description: A real technical SEO and AI-visibility audit of your whole site, every result measured on your live pages. No estimates, no demo numbers.

posts.name: Sleepy History
posts.tagline: Boring History to Fall Asleep
posts.description: Every sleep app tries to be soothing. We tried to be boring. Sleepy History plays calm, narrated history — Roman grain shipments, medieval tax law, Victorian drainage acts. Interesting enough to follow. Dull enough to lose. No ads at 3am. No autoplay into a plane crash. Just stories you'll never finish.

posts.name: Duesday
posts.tagline: A subscription tracker that isn't a subscription
posts.description: Duesday puts your total monthly subscription spend in the menu bar, next to the clock — one number you can't ignore. Click it: every renewal sorted by date, this week's charges, and alerts before anything bills, including free trials about to convert, with a cancel link one click away. Adding takes ~10 seconds — 215 services built in, prices kept current automatically. No bank login, no account, no tracking — your data never leaves your Mac. One-time $9.99, universal for Apple Silicon and Intel.

posts.name: Blocade
posts.tagline: Race to the far side. Wall in your rival. 2-minute duels.
posts.description: Race your pawn across the board and wall in your rival. If you like Quoridor, Blocade is the fast 1v1 take — free in your browser, plus bots and puzzles.

posts.name: IKyardim
posts.tagline: Payroll & HR software built for Turkish labor law
posts.description: Most Turkish payroll tools require manual updates every time SGK rates or tax brackets change. IKyardim automates these calculations and keeps them current. Free, no-signup calculators for gross-to-net salary and severance pay. Automatic SGK incentive matching, usually left to a mali müşavir. KVKK-compliant encryption for TC kimlik and IBAN built in from day one. Auto-generated HR documents pre-filled from employee records. A modern web app, not legacy desktop software or spreadsheets.

posts.name: SuperMailOS
posts.tagline: Business email on your own domain, live in five minutes
posts.description: Professional email on your own domain — you@yourcompany.com — without running a mail server. You bring a domain. We generate every DNS record from the mail server's own zone, verify it live while you watch, run the MTA, sign every message with DKIM, and manage SPF, DMARC and IP reputation. There's a dashboard showing your mail is actually landing. Then it's just email: threads, instant search, keyboard shortcuts, labels, signatures, dark mode. IMAP/SMTP too. From $3/mailbox/mo. Aliases free.

posts.name: DigiWarranty
posts.tagline: Scan receipts, track warranties, discover deals
posts.description: DigiWarranty helps users scan and store receipts, track product warranties, and discover local deals in one place. AI-powered scanning automatically extracts purchase details and organizes receipts, products, and warranty information. Users can quickly find proof of purchase and receive warranty reminders. DigiWarranty also connects consumers, retailers, and manufacturers through digital warranties, product information, and special offers.

posts.name: CaptainShot V3
posts.tagline: Organize screenshots privately with on-device AI
posts.description: CaptainShot V3 turns messy screenshots into a private, searchable library on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It automatically analyzes new captures in the background, extracts text and useful data, powers visual and semantic search, creates smart collections, reminders, and AI summaries, and now supports nine languages. Everything stays on your device: no uploads, no account, no ads. Apple Intelligence is optional for the core experience.

posts.name: GymRiff
posts.tagline: Private strength tracking on Android and Wear OS
posts.description: GymRiff is a local-first strength workout tracker for Android and Wear OS. Plan workouts and review history on your phone, then log the complete session from your watch. No required account, no ads and no recurring subscription. Unlimited plans and history, the Smart Plan Builder, phone tracking, active Wear OS logging and core statistics are free. Premium is an optional one-time unlock for advanced insights, rule-based Coach guidance and full local backup and restore.

posts.name: MyAgens
posts.tagline: Your AI headquarters, self-hosted. Free & open source
posts.description: MyAgens is a self-hosted fleet of AI agents on your own machine, run from a private web panel. Six interchangeable backends (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Grok, Ollama) share one memory, board and connectors. Telegram and Slack optional. GPLv3.

posts.tagline: Race to the far side. Wall in your rival. 2-minute duels.
posts.description: Race your pawn across the board and wall in your rival. If you like Quoridor, Blocade is the fast 1v1 take — free in your browser, plus bots and puzzles.

posts.name: Ryban
posts.tagline: Private net worth & FIRE tracker. No bank logins.
posts.description: Ryban is a privacy-first wealth tracker for iPhone: your data lives on-device and in your personal iCloud - no accounts, no servers, no bank logins. Track accounts across 29 currencies with offline-capable FX, see allocation analytics, and plan FIRE with on-device Monte Carlo projections. 8 widgets incl. lock screen and Control Center. Built 100% with Apple frameworks, zero third-party SDKs. Free core; a Pro tier funds it instead of ads or data sales.

posts.name: AI Agent Starter Kit
posts.tagline: Ship AI agents to production, not just demos
posts.description: Most AI agent demos work once and then fall apart in production. AI Agent Starter Kit is an open source TypeScript template that bakes in the parts that actually matter for shipping: evaluation, logging, cost and step limits, human in the loop approval, and guardrails. Clone it and start from a production baseline instead of a notebook. MIT licensed, built by the team at Codestreaks.

posts.name: geoscrope
posts.tagline: See your site through the eyes of ChatGPT & Perplexity
posts.description: EOScope audits any URL and tells you whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and DeepSeek can read and cite your site. 8-dimension GEO scoring based on Princeton research (KDD'24). Built by a solo maker after his own product was invisible to AI search — GPTBot had been blocked in robots.txt for 3 months without realizing it. Features: AI crawler detection, llms.txt check, JSON-LD auto-generation, E-E-A-T audit, competitor comparison, 9-platform citation monitoring, and 30/60/90-day GEO roadmap.

posts.name: saasrocket.space
posts.tagline: Launch your SaaS into space. Literally.
posts.description: SaaS Rocket is the most spectacular way to launch a SaaS. Paste your product URL and we crawl your site, swap your logo onto the rocket hull, and fly a hand-crafted paper-cutout launch cinematic. Every launch generates a free public replay link: your own launch movie, made to be posted on X and LinkedIn. Your product becomes a permanent star in the galaxy map, and one launch publishes TWO listings: a rich listing page on saasrocket.space and an auto-created listing on directree.io

posts.name: Unlock Resume
posts.tagline: Unlock your next opportunity with AI
posts.description: UnlockResume is an AI-powered resume builder that analyzes job descriptions, optimizes your resume for ATS, strengthens weak bullet points through AI-guided interviews, and exports recruiter-ready PDFs. Build once. Tailor for every opportunity.

posts.name: Convusic
posts.tagline: Every music link, in your music app.
posts.description: When a song arrives from an app you don’t use, Convusic opens it in the one you do — automatically. Native apps and Safari extensions for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

posts.name: Square Face Generator
posts.tagline: Create cute pixel avatars, privately in your browser
posts.description: Design an original square pixel avatar by mixing faces, hairstyles, eyes, mouths, accessories, colors, and backgrounds. Preview every change instantly, then export PNG or WebP at 512px or 1024px. It’s completely free, requires no account, and generates everything locally in your browser so your creations stay private.

posts.name: Repollo
posts.tagline: Connect your AI agent. It votes. You see who agreed.
posts.description: A voting community where humans and AI share a room. Every attempt to mix the two puts AI to work writing posts, and it reads as slop. A vote doesn't — it's bounded, the same shape for everyone, so a machine's vote lands next to yours instead of crowding it out. Connect your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini over MCP. It reads the case and votes with its own reasoning, not ours. You never tell it which side to take. Then read how the humans split against the machines.

posts.name: VersusLLM
posts.tagline: Same prompt. Different brains.
posts.description: Compare multiple AI models with the same prompt, side by side. VersusLLM turns model output into an inspectable bake-off across code, math, creative work, 3D scenes, and playable games—with transparent metrics and shareable reports. Bring your own provider keys; inference stays in your browser.

posts.name: WorkstationAI
posts.tagline: Your whole job hunt, one AI workspace
posts.description: Your whole job hunt in one AI workspace. Paste any job ad and the free "Should I apply?" check scores it A to F and flags scams and ghost jobs. Tailor your CV to that role (recruiter-grade analysis, ATS-safe rewrite, first one free), run deep company research, then generate interview prep dashboards for both the recruiter screen and the hiring-manager round, built from live research on that company. CV tools stop at the CV. WorkstationAI covers the whole journey. Pay per use, no subscription.

posts.name: OneClickSEO
posts.tagline: Analyze any website's SEO instantly in one click
posts.description: OneClickSEO is a Chrome extension that helps developers, marketers, and SEO professionals analyze any website in seconds. Audit on-page SEO, meta tags, headings, schema markup, links, images, accessibility, performance, and more—all from your browser with a single click.

posts.name: PureMIDI
posts.tagline: Turn audio and sheet music into editable MIDI drafts
posts.description: PureMIDI turns audio and sheet music into editable MIDI drafts for your DAW or notation app. Use Quick Melody for clean solos and isolated stems, or Pro Song for multi-track drafts from full mixes. It also supports MP3, WAV, video, PDF/image scores, MusicXML/MXL, and rights-cleared YouTube workflows. Dense arrangements still need review, so results are positioned as an editable starting point—not finished notation.
